build_sentence_similarity_pipeline: build a spaCy SentenceSimilarityPipeline that installs a model from HuggingFace and computes sentence similarity scores
run_sentence_similarity: run the SentenceSimilarityPipeline to compare a source sentence against a list of candidate sentences and return similarity floats
create_spacy_model_loader: create a pipeline that downloads and loads a spaCy model wheel from a HuggingFace namespace and model name
refactor_similarity_computation: refactor the SentenceSimilarityPipeline call method to compute similarity between a source sentence and multiple target sentences
review_model_id_validation: review the SentenceSimilarityPipeline init method that validates the model_id namespace and model name format
